title: Prime in a dyadic interval
statement: For every natural number $n$, there is a prime number $p$ strictly greater than $2^{\ell(n)}$ and at most $2^{\ell(n)+1}$, where $\ell(n)$ is the least natural number $k$ such that $2^k\ge 2n$.
